nodes.label: CuentaRegresiva countdown timer
nodes.rationale: Purely cosmetic timer: the server is the authority on exam time; on reaching zero the page reloads and the server auto-submits the expired attempt.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative exam timing
nodes.rationale: The client countdown is cosmetic; the server owns the deadline and auto-submits expired attempts, so a paused or malicious client cannot buy extra time.
